title: Strings and dynamic bytes ABI
why: ABI encoding of dynamic types (string, bytes, arrays) with unusual lengths, empty values and non-ASCII data exercises different encoder/decoder paths in web3 (EVM) and the solang SCALE metadata path.
hints: Empty string/bytes, exactly 31/32/33 bytes long, multi-kilobyte strings.
Fixed-size byte arrays bytes1..bytes32 as arguments and return values.
